liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dark Star** (4 reviews): Reviewer calls its pre-verse jamming the best of any Dark Star; Reviewer describes Dark Star as explosive [10][13][15][17]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): Reviewer considers this China Cat as good as it gets [13]
- **Playin' In The Band** (1 review): Reviewer calls Playin' typically strong for the era and well jammed [17]
- **Truckin'** (1 review): Reviewer praises the transition from Truckin' into Dark Star as gorgeous [19]

## The recordings

- **gd1972-07-18.sbd.theotherwayne.88658.sbefail.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 28 songs; 242 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [1]. Said about its sound: Master tapes suffered reel decay, and flaws show prominently in some second-set songs [1]
- **gd72-07-18.sbd.cribbs.9067.sbeok.shn**: soundboard; 28 songs; 217 min; rated 4.73/5 by 15 [2]. Said about its sound: Comes A Time is an audience patch in the soundboard; reviewer rates sound B+; Reviewer says this copy is somewhat chopped up and lacks the encore [10][12]
- **gd1972-07-18.sbd.miller.32878.flac16**: soundboard; 28 songs; 215 min; rated 4.55/5 by 22 [4]. Said about its sound: Many tracks still carry static and buzzing from the piano [4]
- **gd72-07-18.aud.weiner.5916.sbefail.shnf**: audience recording; 23 songs; 178 min; rated 3.9/5 by 10 [5]. Said about its sound: Audience tape sounds good if the low and high ends are boosted [19]
- **gd1972-07-18.sbd.lai.3348.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 183 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [7]

## Around the show

- Reviewer lives near Jersey City; says the band loved the stadium and played three sets, which was unusual then [9]
- Reviewer says Bob Dylan was backstage, unknown to the crowd [9]
- Reviewer believes this was the biggest crowd the band had played to up to then, beginning the stadium era [15]
- Encore One More Saturday Night is missing from this copy [2]
- Reviewer prefers this audience tape to the soundboard, citing the excitement in the room [13]
- Reviewer ranks this Comes A Time among favorites, behind only the 5/9/77 version [17]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1972-07-18.sbd.theotherwayne.88658.sbefail.shnf**: transferred by theotherwayne; source: SMR>?>DAT>WAV>CDR>SHN [1]. Also: Dropouts were spliced back in from a second PCM source into the DAT source using Samplitude [1]
- **gd72-07-18.sbd.cribbs.9067.sbeok.shn**: source: Soundboard [2]. Also: Soundboard with audience patches, via David Hollister, seeded to etree by Sean Cribbs [2]
- **gd1972-07-18.sbd.miller.32878.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Cassette -> Dat -> CD [4]. Also: Audience patches fill soundboard gaps; patch chain went through cassette and DAT to CD; Uploader patched dropouts, fixed tape pauses, and removed pops and static with Cool Edit Pro 2.0 [4]
- **gd72-07-18.aud.weiner.5916.sbefail.shnf**: source: Audience [5]
- **gd1972-07-18.sbd.lai.3348.shnf**: source: sdb>>master reel>>reel>>pcm>>cdr [7]. Also: This copy lacks the third set and the encore [7]

## Art and photos

- Poster by visionsofdylan.blogspot.com: [7-18-72 Roosevelt Stadium 50th Anniversary](https://visionsofdylan.blogspot.com/2022/07/7-18-72-roosevelt-stadium-50th.html) [21]
